title: Component Specification Schema
description: JSON Schema for component spec YAML files (docs/_spec/components/*.yml). This is the canonical structural specification that formalizes component-spec-yaml.mdc and component-spec-properties-order.mdc. All other rules and scripts must reference this schema instead of duplicating the constraints.
$comment: Thin-rule companion: .agents/rules/component-spec-yaml.mdc. Canonical machine-readable companions: tooling/lib/property-type-map.json (type mapping + ordering groups), tooling/scripts/ds-sort-spec.mjs (deterministic property order), tooling/scripts/lib/name.mjs (name/slug normalization). ready specs require concrete defaults and deterministic figma.component_set_node_id.

name.description: PascalCase component name matching the Figma component set name exactly.

status.description: Spec status. 'draft': incomplete or unverified. 'ready': reviewed and matches Figma. No other values allowed. 'needs-review' is NOT valid here (that field belongs to markdown doc_status).

version.description: Optional semantic versioning for spec and component independently.

component_set_node_id.description: Figma node ID in 'X:Y' format. Recommended in draft, required in ready specs for deterministic placement.

properties.description: Component properties mapping 1:1 to Figma component set properties. Must follow deterministic ordering: enum, text, boolean, instance_swap (see component-spec-properties-order.mdc).

inner.description: Token path for inner focus outline.

outer.description: Token path for outer focus outline.

desktop_token.description: A11y token for desktop minimum hit area (AA). Should be A11y.A11y.Dimension.Min-Hit-Area.

mobile_token.description: A11y token for mobile minimum hit area (AAA). Should be Primitives.Dimension.A11y.Min-Hit-Area-Mobile-AAA.

token_mapping.description: Maps anatomical part + CSS property + condition to token paths. Keys are 'part.property' or 'part.property.subproperty'. Values are objects keyed by condition (e.g., 'state=Default', 'type=Primary,state=Hover') with token path strings as values. Token paths can be TBD.

qa.description: Verification statements. Minimum 2 items: property match + token validity checks.

related_components.description: Optional array of snake_case component slugs for related components. Duplicates not allowed. Must not include the current component's slug. For 'ready' specs, all entries must resolve to existing spec files.

figma_node_id.description: Figma node ID format: two integers separated by a colon (e.g., '123:456').

semver.description: Semantic version string (X.Y.Z format, optionally with prerelease or build metadata).

property.description: A component property mapping to a Figma component property.

name.description: Property name as it appears in Figma. May contain special characters (e.g., '↳ Change txt').

type.description: Canonical spec type. Must match one of the valid types from property-type-map.json. Case-insensitive comparison is done at validation time.

values.description: Array of allowed values. REQUIRED when type='enum'. OMIT for text, boolean, instance_swap. When status='ready', values must NOT contain 'TBD' as an entry—this does not satisfy the concrete-default requirement.

default.description: Default value in Figma. Format depends on type: enum → one of values[] or 'TBD'; text → any string or 'TBD'; boolean → true|false (unquoted YAML) or 'TBD'; instance_swap → component name or 'TBD'. When status='ready', all defaults must be concrete (not 'TBD').

required.description: Whether this property is required in Figma.

description.description: Human-readable description of the property's purpose.

values.description: Enum must have at least one value.
Ready specs cannot have 'TBD' as a value option.
